result.topic_en: Notes on invariants of binary quartic and cubic forms (covariants, linear substitutions) followed by calculations with the product expansion of sin and sinh, the partial-fraction expansion of coth, and an integral of e^{-sx}/x (1/(e^x-1) - 1/x + 1/2) expanded via Bernoulli-type series and Stirling's formula.
result.transcription:
$(a,b,c,d,e)$
$3c^2-4bd+ae=\mathfrak{A}$
$c^3-2cbd-cae+ad^2+eb^2=\mathfrak{B}$
$b^2-ac=\delta$
$a^3\mathfrak{B}-a^2\delta\mathfrak{A}+4\delta^3=n^2$
$b^3-3\delta b\equiv n \mod a^2$
$b^2-\delta\equiv 0 \mod a$

$(a,b,c,d)\sim(b^2-ac,\frac{bc-ad}{2},c^2-bd)$
$=(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)$
$\alpha b^2-2ab\beta+a^2\gamma=\alpha^2 \quad \alpha^3=(\alpha b-\beta a)^2-Da^2$
$a\gamma-2b\beta+c\alpha=0 \quad b\gamma-2c\beta+d\alpha=0$
$a'=a(\frac{t-\beta u}{m})+b\frac{\alpha u}{m}$
$b'=-a\frac{\gamma u}{m}+b\frac{t+\beta u}{m}=+c\frac{\alpha u}{m}+b\frac{t-\beta u}{m}$
$c'=-b\frac{\gamma u}{m}+c\frac{t+\beta u}{m}=c\frac{t-\beta u}{m}+d\frac{\alpha u}{m}$
$d'=-c\frac{\gamma u}{m}+d\frac{t+\beta u}{m}$

$\log\sin\pi x=\log\pi x+\sum\log(1-\frac{x^2}{n^2})$
$\log\frac{e^{\pi x}-e^{-\pi x}}{2}=\log\pi x+\sum_{1,\infty}\log(1+\frac{x^2}{n^2})$
$[-\log\frac{e^x-e^{-x}}{2}-]=\log\frac{x}{2}+\sum\log(1+\frac{x^2}{4n^2\pi^2})$
$-\log\frac{x}{2}-\sum\frac{1}{m}(-\frac{x^2}{4n^2\pi^2})^m$
$\pi\frac{e^{2\pi x}+1}{e^{2\pi x}-1}=\frac{1}{x}+\sum\frac{2x}{n^2}\frac{1}{1+\frac{x^2}{n^2}}$

$\frac12\frac{e^{x/2}+e^{-x/2}}{e^{x/2}-e^{-x/2}}=\frac{1}{x}-2\sum\frac{(-1)^m}{(2\pi)^{2m}}x^{2m-1}$[?]

$\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{-sx}}{x}(\frac{1}{e^x-1}-\frac1x+\frac12)dx=-2\sum\frac{(-1)^m}{(2\pi)^{2m}}\sum_{1,\infty}\frac{1}{n^{2m}}\int_0^\infty e^{-sx}x^{2m-2}dx$
$=-2\sum\frac{(-1)^m\Pi(2m-2)}{(2\pi)^{2m}s^{2m-1}}\sum_{1,\infty}\frac{1}{n^{2m}}$

$\frac{2m-2}{2\pi s}$ $\quad 2\pi s=2m-2=t$
$\log\Pi(2m-2)=[-(\ldots+\frac12)\log-]\ \log t\,(t+\frac12)-t$
$-(t+1)\log t$
$-\frac12\log t \quad -t$

$\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{-2\pi sx}}{x}\frac{dx}{2\pi}\sum\frac{2x}{n^2}\frac{1}{1+\frac{x^2}{n^2}}$ $\quad \frac{(-1)^m}{\pi}\int_0^\infty e^{-2\pi sx}dx\sum\frac{x^{2m}}{n^{2m+2}(1+\frac{x^2}{n^2})}$

$\frac{1}{1+\frac{x^2}{n^2}}=\sum_{0,m-1}(-\frac{x^2}{n^2})^\mu+(-\frac{x^2}{n^2})^m\frac{1}{1+\frac{x^2}{n^2}}$

methods.what: Invariants of binary quartic form and relation with congruence conditions
Hessian-type covariant of binary cubic and linear substitution (automorphs)
Product expansion of sine / sinh in logarithmic form
Binet-type integral for log Gamma remainder expanded as asymptotic series with zeta values
Stirling approximation for log of factorial
Finite geometric expansion with remainder for 1/(1+x^2/n^2)
